title: Weight status of children and adolescents with autism spectrum disorder: A cross-sectional analysis of primary care electronic medical records and linked health administrative datasets in Ontario, Canada.
authors: Kinlin LM, Saunders NR, Carsley S, Keown-Stoneman C, Tu K, Zwaigenbaum L, Birken CS.
figures: Identification of eligible visits in the Electronic Medical Records Primary Care (EMRPC) database between January 2011 and December 2016. OHIP, Ontario Health Insurance Plan. zBMI, age‐ and sex‐standardized body mass index  z ‐score.

Odds ratio of the specified weight status versus normal weight in children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD), compared to those without ASD, by age group. The vertical black line indicates an odds ratio of 1 (i.e., no difference). zBMI, age‐ and sex‐standardized body mass index  z ‐score.
